items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ApplicationStartup that it runs with.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ApplicationStartup 通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: applicationStartup - application startup to be used by this object
items.translation: applicationStartup - 此对象将使用的应用程序启动事件

items.source:
Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init
callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method.
Invoked before ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但早于初始化回调（如 InitializingBean 的 afterPropertiesSet 或自定义 init-method）之前被调用。在 ApplicationContextAware 的 setApplicationContext 之前被调用。

items.source: Set the ApplicationStartup that this object runs with.
items.translation: 设置该对象运行的 ApplicationStartup。
